title: Please Vent More
exact_first_slide_text: please vent more. i don't want the short version.
one_line_concept: Aachu starts editing her rant because she feels annoying; Zuv makes it clear he wants the long version.
why_it_wins: All three Idea Room agents independently selected the vent-more family.
It preserves a permissioned source lead instead of inventing a generic listening lesson.
It is supported by owned A Story performance: the top send-behavior winner proves 'you are not too much' travels, and the listening winner proves this emotional lane can be shared.
The first frame can be staged as real couple behavior without quote-card drift: phone face-down, one person mid-rant, one person visibly staying.

source_basis.source_gap: DZS2GuipLku has public likes/comments and comment smell but no scraped saves/shares; selection uses it as source lead, not as sole performance proof.
